WITH lt AS (SELECT DISTINCT fl.market_ticker t FROM fills fl JOIN live_orders lo ON lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id
            WHERE lo.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%' AND split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXMLBSPREAD','KXMLBTOTAL','KXMLBHR','KXMLBKS','KXRAIN','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFWMATCH','KXITFMATCH') AND fl.filled_at>='2026-07-01'),
p AS (
  SELECT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, market_ticker t, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) game,
         quantity::numeric q, pnl::numeric pnl
  FROM paper_trades
  WHERE split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXMLBSPREAD','KXMLBTOTAL','KXMLBHR','KXMLBKS','KXRAIN','KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFWMATCH','KXITFMATCH')
    AND status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL
    AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins)
    AND created_at >= '2026-07-15' AND created_at < '2026-10-05'
    AND (CASE WHEN coalesce(lower(side),'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END) <= 11),
c AS (SELECT p.*, (p.t IN (SELECT t FROM lt)) AS live_mkt FROM p),
m AS (SELECT ser, live_mkt, t, sum(pnl) mp, sum(q) mq FROM c GROUP BY 1,2,3)
SELECT ser, CASE WHEN live_mkt THEN 'live-filled' ELSE 'not-live' END grp, count(*) mkts, sum(mq)::int contracts,
       round(100*sum(mp)/sum(mq),2) c_per_ct, round(100.0*avg((mp<0)::int),1) mkt_loss_pct,
       round(sum(mp),2) net
FROM m GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
